_comment: Experiment 43, arm B, d = 4: Zhang et al. 2020's 4D list, 1e6 samples for L <= 64 and 1e5 above, TRUNCATED at L = 128 because L = 176, 192 exceed the int32 label space of percolation_zd_gpu (128^4 is the largest box it labels). Not the published protocol: their top two sizes carry ~80% of the budget. About 6.2e13 cost units, ~4 GPU-hours per replicate.
source: Zhang et al. 2020, arXiv:2004.11289, Sec. II (4D), truncated at L = 128
